turns.question: What was our best week between Monday 17 August and Sunday 27 September 2026, and what did it bring in?
turns.answer: Our best week in the period was 21 to 27 September 2026 (weeks run Monday to Sunday), which brought in EUR 3,387.25 of revenue and EUR 3,387.25 of net revenue after partner returns, as no returns were recorded that week. Fresh: returns.silver is ready up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
